skill.name: ghe-thread-manager
skill.description: Manage GitHub issue transcription state, switch active issue threads, and create background feature threads through GHE helper scripts.
skill.summary: Coordinate GitHub issue threads, transcription state, and background GHE work.
skill.author: Emasoft

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and inline command names. Confirmed issues remain for hidden home-directory writes, predictable temporary issue state, public GitHub transcription, absolute prompt-priority language, and shell commands that may receive user-controlled text. The author should tighten permissions, state storage, command invocation, and consent boundaries before publication.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the IRON LAW wording and state that skill guidance is subordinate to platform policy, developer instructions, and security review.
Require explicit confirmation before enabling transcription, display repository visibility, and provide secret redaction guidance.
Remove permission to write ~/.claude, or require explicit user approval and narrow changes to named configuration files.
Store previous issue state in a project-scoped file with restricted permissions, and validate issue numbers before use.
Use structured tool invocation or argument arrays for helper scripts, validate issue numbers, and shell-escape user-provided titles and descriptions.

static_findings.snippet: **The `auto_transcribe.py` script automatically tracks the last active issue.** When you clear or sw
- When you call `clear-issue`: Previous issue is saved automatically
- When you call `set-issue N` while on another issue: Previous issue is saved automatically
If `last_active_issue.json` doesn't exist (e.g., first session or file deleted), search GitHub:
| "work on the login bug" | ON → found issue | `set-issue N` (after search) |
| "what were we working on?" | Report last | `get-last-issue` |
| "continue where we left off" | ON → last found | `resume` |
| `auto_transcribe.py set-issue N` | Select issue | YES - turns ON to #N |
| `auto_transcribe.py clear-issue` | Stop transcription | YES - turns OFF (saves previous to last_ac
| `auto_transcribe.py get-last-issue` | Show last active issue | NO |
| `auto_transcribe.py last-issue-number` | Get issue number only (for scripting) | NO |
| `auto_transcribe.py resume` | Resume last active issue | YES - turns ON to last issue |
| `create_feature_thread.py` | Create background thread | NO - main unchanged |

content.value_statement: Teams lose context when AI work moves across GitHub issues and background tasks. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code track the active issue, manage transcription state, and create review threads.
actual_capabilities: Interprets issue switching, status, resume, review, and privacy intents from natural language.
Checks and changes the current GitHub issue transcription state through GHE helper scripts.
Creates background feature or bug threads without changing the main conversation state.
Checks whether background work is ready for review.
Provides required notification text for active, switched, and stopped transcription.
Searches recent GitHub issues when the last active issue is unavailable.
limitations: Requires the GHE plugin scripts and a correctly configured CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
Requires GitHub CLI authentication for issue search and comment inspection.
Can publish conversation content to GitHub when transcription is active.
Does not implement, review, or merge code by itself; other GHE agents handle delivery.

use_cases.title: Switch Active Issue Context
use_cases.description: Move between GitHub issues while preserving transcription state and user notifications.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Background Work
use_cases.description: Create feature or bug threads while keeping the main conversation on its current issue.

use_cases.title: Join Review Threads Safely
use_cases.description: Enter a review issue, understand the new transcription target, and return to prior context.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: What issue are we working on right now?
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need the current transcription state before discussing work.

prompt_templates.title: Switch to an Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Switch to issue 42 and tell me whether transcription is active.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you want the assistant to move the active GitHub thread.

prompt_templates.title: Create Background Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a background feature thread for adding dark mode, but keep this chat in its current transcription state.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a new task should run separately from the main discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Recover and Resume Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the last active issue, summarize it, and ask before resuming transcription.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when returning to prior work without remembering the issue number.

output_examples.output: The assistant reports whether an issue is selected and states if transcription is on or private.
The assistant changes the active issue, announces that transcription is active, and explains that GitHub will receive future exchanges.
The assistant creates a background issue for the work and states whether the main conversation remains private or stays on the current issue.

best_practices: Confirm the active issue before discussing private or customer data.
Use go private or stop tracking before sharing secrets or sensitive context.
Keep GHE helper scripts reviewed and pinned before enabling this skill.
anti_patterns: Do not assume transcription is private after joining or switching issues.
Do not use this skill without GitHub permissions for the target repository.
Do not let background issue creation change the main conversation state.

faq.question: Does this skill post messages to GitHub?
faq.answer: Yes, when transcription is active. It requires notifications that explain the active GitHub issue target.

faq.question: Can I stop transcription?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask to stop tracking, go private, or stop transcribing to turn transcription off.

faq.question: Does creating a background thread switch my active issue?
faq.answer: No. Background feature and bug threads are independent from the main conversation state.

faq.question: What tools does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs the GHE helper scripts, a valid plugin root, and GitHub CLI access for issue lookup.

faq.question: Can it find the last active issue?
faq.answer: Yes. It can check saved state and can search recent GitHub issues as a fallback.

faq.question: Is it safe for secrets?
faq.answer: No. Treat active transcription as public GitHub posting and stop tracking before sharing secrets.
